text:
SupportOps Bot: FYI: spike in tagged questions from demos this week: `retention`, `audit-logs`, `siem`, `data-residency` (based on Support intake + AE forwards).

Rafael Mendes: Hey all — Support is getting the same question in live demo follow-ups like 3x/day: “what’s your retention?” and “do you have audit logs / can you export to Splunk?”

Rafael Mendes: Can we get an internal KB entry we can point AEs/SEs to? Right now answers vary and we’re worried someone will over-commit on specifics in writing.

Naomi Feldman: +1. We already have the Demo Tenant Security FAQ in Confluence with approved wording. We should not invent exact retention windows in Slack/email.

Naomi Feldman: Link (internal): confluence://sales-enablement/security-faq/demo-tenant-security-faq — sections “Data handling, logging, and retention” + “Audit logs, monitoring, and incident response” are the relevant bits.

Kevin Osei: The part that keeps tripping folks up is “audit logs” meaning different things.
- Demo tenant: we keep operational metadata (request IDs, timestamps, status, token counts, latency)
- Enterprise: audit/event visibility + exports depend on deployment + plan; we validate SIEM specifics in security review

Kevin Osei: I’d strongly recommend the KB include a “what to say live” + “what NOT to claim” block.

Marcus Lin: Agree. Also add explicit guidance: if a prospect says they pasted sensitive data, stop + capture timeframe/request IDs and escalate. We’ve had a couple near-misses.

Markus Klein: From the field side, this is real. During the standard demo, security folks ask for:
1) exact retention days
2) whether prompts/outputs are stored
3) audit log events list + SIEM export
If we don’t have a single copy/paste answer, AEs will freestyle.

Soojin Lee: For the deck/talk track, we’ve been using the “30-second answers” from Naomi’s FAQ, but Support should absolutely have a KB we can link in follow-ups. Can we make it super explicit that the demo tenant != compliance boundary?

Elliot Price: I can draft an internal KB entry today and link back to the Confluence FAQ as the source of truth. Where do you want it housed — Support KB (internal) or sales-enablement space?

Rafael Mendes: Support KB please (we can link to it from Jira macros + canned responses). Also include a short snippet we can paste into follow-up emails.

Naomi Feldman: Suggest KB structure:
- TL;DR (copy/paste)
- Demo tenant logging posture (payload capture off; metadata on)
- Retention guidance (short-lived; don’t guess exact)
- Audit logs / SIEM (plan-dependent; validate in security review)
- Escalation path + what to capture

Kevin Osei: + add “SIEM export” safe line: “For enterprise plans, we support exporting relevant logs/telemetry to customer tooling depending on deployment model; specifics confirmed in eval.” (No vendor promises in the demo.)

Marcus Lin: Please include an “If asked for SOC2 / pen test / DPA” line: route to security package process, don’t attach random PDFs.

Elliot Price: Done. I’ll post draft here for review before publishing. Target: EOD.

Markus Klein: Once it’s live, I’ll ask Renee/Sooj in to add the KB link to the standard demo follow-up email template and the talk track sidebar.

Rafael Mendes: Perfect. Thanks all. This will save Support a ton of back-and-forth + keep us from making accidental commitments.
